hooks.name: Update docs
hooks.description: Manual hook: refresh the README 'How we used Kiro' section and append a dated entry to KIRO_LOG.md. NOTE: v1 has no general-purpose manual invoke, so the actually-runnable version is the manual-inclusion steering command /update-docs (.kiro/steering/update-docs.md). This file documents the intended automation and lists it in the Agent Hooks panel.
